items.text: Courses for students with low marks after 10th include ITI trades, polytechnic diplomas where eligible, vocational and skill programmes, open schooling and short certificate courses, and low marks are not the end of choices, since many routes value practical ability and steady effort.
Choose a route that builds a skill with a clear job link, verify the institution and keep the door open to more study later.
Verify recognition and avoid agents promising guaranteed jobs.
